_about: Test photos of what a kitchen really has, made with an image model (gemini-3-pro-image) for this test; no real kitchen, person or company. Each entry says what must be read from the photo. dishes: one folded fragment per dish, found in the dish as written or as named. marks: dietary rules written on single dishes. notes: rules from notes on the page as [kind, scope, head count]. held: dishes that must wait for the chef's answer, with the portions held. tests/menu.py reads every photo through POST /api/menu/read and plans it.

lounaslista.jpg.what: A phone photo of a printed Finnish lunch list taped to a steel door. The head count is handwritten under it.

whiteboard.jpg.what: A handwritten week plan on a whiteboard, Finnish, with two dietary counts in red marker.

staffparty.jpg.what: A typed staff party note with guests, an allergy note and a budget.

wedding-margin.jpg.what: A printed wedding menu with dietary notes scribbled in the margin.

email.jpg.what: A screenshot of an email ordering a seminar lunch, with dietary counts and a budget per person in the text.

lowlight.jpg.what: A slanted low-light phone photo of a Finnish Christmas party menu on a clipboard, with a handwritten note.

receipt.jpg.what: A grocery receipt. Nothing to cook from.

pricelist.jpg.what: A wholesaler's price list. Products with prices, no dishes.
